title: A Portrait for the Room
author: Noor Voss
blurb: Theo Iversen, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the ritual the founders started, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
